name: Steam
summary: Game store and launcher by Valve

config.notes: The game library (steamapps) is never carried: Steam re-downloads it from the account. On Windows the settings and the per-user data live under the installation directory (Program Files (x86)/Steam/config and /userdata), which DHS is not allowed to address, so the Windows section carries only the identifiers; on Linux the same files are under the data directory and are backed up. Cloud saves come back from Steam Cloud on their own.
